content.text: When travelling to Guwahati one should not miss visiting the Assam State Museum , located at the heart of the city in Dighali. All you need to know about Assam is under this one roof. From the rich cultural history, to the lifestyle of the locals, ancient history as well as modern history. It is also one of the most famous museums situated in the North East of India.
“ Art and love are the same thing: It’s the process of seeing yourself in things that are not you.”
Chuck Klosterman

This quote rightly describes the Maati Centre. Maati Centre as the name suggests is a place that displays works or artists, handicrafts and a great maati collection. The place is well maintained and has a good quality of products that you can purchase from. The products are of high quality ranging from handlooms, handicrafts and many more that are great gifting items. All the items present there are handcrafted by the rural craftsmen belonging to the North East of India. These small initiatives have given craftsmen a platform to display their work and earn a livelihood.

One of the popular tourist destinations is Dispur, the capital of Assam. Being the capital of Assam, Dispur is known for a number of things . If you happen to visit during the winters then you will notice that the city is flooded with a lot of migratory birds, this majestic view attracts many tourists and birdwatchers. And if you’re one then definitely visit this place.

The main reason why many tourists are attracted to Sualkuchi weaver’s village is that it is famous for delicately woven mekhela chador. You will definitely fall in love and would like to purchase them.

The Guwahati Memorial Park is in honor of those who lost their lives while fighting for the nation. In December, 2016 the war memorial was open for public visits. The memorial is often flocked by many tourists and known for its architecture and design. Its main objective is to acknowledge the lives laid down by soldiers for their beloved nation.

If you are a collector of cars and bikes or fascinated by them, the Treasured Wheels is the right place for you. Witness a grand collection of cars and bikes including vintage ones. Some other vintage items include fuel tanks, clocks, cameras, bicycles and gramophones. People often visit this place for its grand collection and many families spend the weekend here in camps or tree houses. There is an outdoor place where games can be placed. The provision of mobile kitchens are also there for you to have a fun time.

Brahmaputra River is one of India’s largest river. A rail cum road bridge has been built here. The river is situated on the bank of Guwahati City. The people of Guwahati often come to visit this place and chilled themselves against scorching heat. On the Brahmaputra River, Tourist also enjoy river cruise.
The travel time from Shillong to Guwahati is about 2 hr 45 min(99.2km)via NH6. Usually travellers do stop at Nongpoh while travelling from Shillong to Guwahati.
